card.text: TOI-2180 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-2180 b"
sources.quote: TOI-2180 b is a giant exoplanet orbiting the G-type star TOI-2180, also known as HD 238894.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-2180. Its orbit and size follow Dalba et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-2180 b"
sources.quote: It was discovered with the help of the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite and is currently the exoplanet with the longest orbital period TESS was able to uncover.
